cost_model_summary:
High level assumptions used in the model: H100 equivalent instances; per-GPU amortized infra cost $6.50/hr, software/ops overlay $1.20/hr -> effective $7.70/hr/GPU. Measured steady-state throughput (mixed chat+embed workload): ~1.05M tokens/hr per H100 (sustained, 32k context average).

Scenarios:
- Scenario A (Conservative commit): Reserve 8 GPUs. Assumed utilization 40% (pilot conservative). Effective cost per 1k tokens = $0.00183 -> annualized cost ~ $270k/yr.
- Scenario B (Target): Reserve 16 GPUs. Assumed utilization 65%. Effective cost per 1k tokens = $0.00085 -> annualized cost ~ $455k/yr.
- Scenario C (Aggressive commit + burst): Reserve 32 GPUs + burst pool. Assumed utilization 78% overall. Effective cost per 1k tokens = $0.00047 -> annualized cost ~ $820k/yr.

Notes: These per-token numbers include reserved compute + Redwood platform fees and do NOT include networking egress or third-party model licensing. We carved margin for autoscale burst credits in Scenarios B/C. Customer asked for modeled sensitivity sweeps at +/-10% utilization and +/-20% token-size variance.
sla_requirements: Customer requested: throughput guarantee (baseline sustained QPS 12k, burst to 40k for 15 minutes), latency SLOs p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms for token generation on recommended LLaMA-derivative model. Wants credit-based SLA: 5% service credit for each 0.1% below 99.9% monthly p95 target. Redwood to propose measurable SLA metric (per-route, per-model).
procurement_notes: Procurement focus: 12-month vs 24-month discount tiers, exit clauses tied to failure to meet p95 SLOs for 2 consecutive months, indemnity limits. They prefer a blended ARR number for budget — aim to keep first year under $600k if possible. Negotiation redlines expected on liability and audit access. Will push for a trial RPU-based billing for first 90 days.
technical_requirements: VPC-only control plane, dedicated subnets in us-east-1/us-west-2/eu-west-1, HSM integration for key wrap, 3-year key rotation policy acceptable. Need traffic mirroring for shadow runs and Prometheus metrics ingest for latency QPS dashboards. SE note: verify MTU and NAT gateway capacity during pilot.
pilot_plan: 30-day pilot: 16 GPU reserved equivalence in test account w/ 40% commit credit + 8 GPU burst pool. Goals: validate p95 latency <250ms at 65% util, validate end-to-end trace ingestion to Redwood Console, validate KV cache hit rate improvements (>18% token reduction expected) during personalization flows.
